title: Close the 2026-07-24 SRD audit and establish clause-complete pack execution
description:
Umbrella for the repair program answering the 2026-07-24 multi-model SRD audit
(independent Sol review, Opus 5 review + creature/magic-item amendment,
GPT-5.6-Sol agent review, Fable 5 review). Source plan:
/mnt/d/eshyra-2026-07-24-audit-repair-bead-plan.md.

The program satisfies two independent requirements:

1. Holistic correction — repair the construction model, compiler boundaries,
   validation approach, and engine-capability accounting that let whole classes
   of defect survive. The semantic unit becomes a source-backed clause, not a
   record; records become materialized views grouping clauses.
2. Finding closure — every numbered finding from all four reviews maps to at
   least one bead with regression evidence that prevents recurrence.

Four meanings currently collapsed into "modeled" must be separated and reported
independently per clause: CAPTURED (source clause present), PROJECTED (complete
deterministic meaning represented), SUPPORTED (engine implements every required
primitive), DISCOVERABLE (DM/tools can find the canonical rule and its
execution/adjudication boundary). A clause is not playable because it is
captured or partially projected.

Blocks re-freeze: eshyra-2zyy (restore SRD thaw-note gating) and eshyra-o9bd.14
(regenerate + re-freeze) must not proceed until this epic closes.

Verified against main @4384f25 on 2026-07-24 (packages/core/data/rules-packs/
rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json, 1,813 records).

acceptance_criteria:
- Every finding in the plan's §IV coverage matrix maps to a completed bead and a committed regression test.
- Every source clause and every structured output field is bidirectionally reconciled.
- No unresolved or ambiguous source ownership is counted as complete coverage.
- Every deterministic clause is completely projected, or carries a precise in-band non-engine disposition.
- Every required engine capability is green or covered by an approved explicit house-rule/design dependency.
- No pending capability lacks a real, open bead.
- A fresh audit bundle receives zero repeat findings from independent max-level reviews.
- No semantically sampled record family remains in the coverage-depth matrix.
notes:
Standing caution (bd memory o9bd-reverify-pack-before-implementing-children):
re-verify the committed pack before implementing ANY child. Successive audit
rounds have repeatedly named deficiencies that a later snapshot already fixed.
Records use the "key" field, not "id".

Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership

cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,

*** GREEN DEFINITION REVISED (2026-07-25) — SUPERSEDES the 8-point version ***
DECISION: where structured pack data is a DIRECT INPUT to deterministic
execution, the pack contract and the reference engine are ONE co-designed
system. The pack defines what the engine must execute; the reference engine
proves the representation is sufficient and unambiguous. Freezing the pack
first would preserve a separation that does not exist in practice.

A deterministic clause that feeds engine execution is GREEN only when all nine
hold:
  1. Complete source-clause identification.
  2. Clause-complete structured representation.
  3. Complete field provenance.
  4. Explicit capability requirements.
  5. A provider-neutral engine implementation exists.
  6. Reference-engine conformance tests exercise the PACK representation.
  7. Correct tool exposure and state mutation.
  8. Fail-closed behavior for unsupported input.
  9. Successful replay / deterministic equivalence where applicable.

A clause is NOT green merely because the pack appears to contain enough data;
the reference implementation must demonstrate that it actually does. A
representation reference that merely RESOLVES to an existing object is not
green — the Opus amended magic-item pass proved reference integrity but
explicitly did NOT prove semantic appropriateness of free-form effects.

AT RE-FREEZE THERE MUST BE ZERO ENGINE-PENDING DETERMINISTIC CLAUSES. The only
permissible non-green clauses are four approved categories:
  * genuine source ambiguity routed to campaign rulings;
  * intentionally model-adjudicated material;
  * external content unavailable in the SRD;
  * explicitly deferred non-deterministic house-rule behavior.
Each must be explicitly represented in-band, carry its alternatives and
campaign-ruling requirement, and fail CLOSED.

WHY (audit evidence): the 2026-07-24 findings were structures that looked
plausible in isolation but failed as executable inputs — alternative damage
modes stored as parallel damage, recharge triggers read as reset periods,
partial saves treated as complete, legendary actions with no budget or cost,
option mechanics hoisted onto parent features, typed records missing
branching/timing/termination. A completed reference implementation forces these
to surface: a dragon-breath scenario cannot pass without half-damage handling;
a legendary-creature scenario cannot pass without a budget; a versatile attack
cannot execute without a discriminated alternative.

CONSEQUENCE FOR SEQUENCING: eshyra-olc5 is no longer a downstream project that
may stay open after eshyra-o9bd closes. Its reference-implementation
certification gates eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1 and therefore the formal re-freeze in
eshyra-o9bd.14.
*** ENGINE CERTIFICATION NOW GATES RE-FREEZE (2026-07-25) ***
Earlier framing allowed the pack to be re-frozen with engine work still open,
on the theory that this is a pack-data audit rather than an engine-completion
audit. That is superseded for every deterministic clause that is a DIRECT INPUT
to engine execution.

eshyra-olc5's reference-engine certification now blocks eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1, and
therefore the entire closure chain down to eshyra-o9bd.14. See the revised
nine-point green definition above.

The pack/engine SEPARATION still holds as a modeling discipline — an
engine-pending clause is not automatically a pack defect, and the two questions
stay distinguishable. What changed is the freeze gate, not the taxonomy.
*** ADR 0020 NARROWING (2026-07-31) — THIS EPIC'S RE-FREEZE BAR IS REPLACED ***
Authority: ADR 0020 ("Prior assumptions" item 4) and the integrated transition
design docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/
2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md section 5.9 — the accepted deliverable
of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). Recorded as accepted authority; no
code was changed by this bead update.

The line above in these notes — "AT RE-FREEZE THERE MUST BE ZERO ENGINE-PENDING
DETERMINISTIC CLAUSES" — is WITHDRAWN. It requires a global negative the corpus
cannot support. Its replacement is the nine-condition truthfulness bar recorded
in full on eshyra-o9bd.14 and referenced by eshyra-2zyy: source fidelity;
truthful provenance; deterministic reproducibility; truthful in-band scope for
every audit and readiness artifact; durable disposition of known findings;
correctness of positively selected capabilities; no known source invention; no
unowned live runtime safety contract; and explicit statement of unresolved
discovery and adjudication limits. Explicitly not required: global deterministic
closure, universal discovery completeness, zero engine-pending clauses, or any
corpus-wide negative claim. The nine-point GREEN definition survives as a
per-clause quality definition for clauses positively selected for deterministic
execution; it is no longer a corpus-wide gate. eshyra-olc5 carries the matching
engine-side narrowing and the bounded meaning of engine:F1-F10.
